poses.name: speaking
poses.prompt: This is an RGBA image with transparency. Use image 1 as the front character reference and image 2 as the side character reference. Create one visual novel dialogue sprite of exactly the same character, preserving her face, silver side ponytail, ribbon, navy sailor uniform, white neck scarf, gold emblems, pleated skirt, dark thigh-high stockings and black shoes. Full body, standing upright facing the viewer, head level, both feet resting naturally, entire hair and shoes inside the frame. She is speaking calmly with a small friendly smile and her mouth slightly open. One forearm is gently bent with an open palm near waist level in a restrained conversational gesture; the other arm hangs relaxed. Keep the gesture close to the body. Match the reference art style and proportions. One character and one view only. The image has an alpha channel and the background is transparent.
